$comment: A retrieval corpus for one golden project. Copy this per project and name
the file after the project code.
HOW TO WRITE A CASE. Ask the question the way an estimator would ask it,
not the way the document is worded - retrieval that only works when you
already know the phrasing is retrieval that only works for the person who
Name a page only when the answer is genuinely on that page. A case naming
only the document passes on any page of it, which is right for a question
the whole document answers; over-specifying makes a correct answer fail.
'note' is printed when the case misses. Say why the case exists, so a
failure leads somewhere instead of being a number that went down.

cases.question: what concrete strength is specified for the structural slabs
cases.note: The single most-asked question on any structural package.

cases.question: fire rating between the plant room and the corridor
cases.note: Whole-document case: the fire strategy is stated in several places.

cases.question: A-201
cases.note: Identifier-only. FULLTEXT drops tokens this short, so this case exercises the LIKE fallback rather than the index.
